svg.title: My portfolio — joshua-camacho.dev
svg.desc: A particle portrait built in three.js follows you through black and white bands: real project media, a GitHub wall, a downloadable résumé and certificates. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, three.js, Tailwind CSS. Visit joshua-camacho.dev.
